purpose: Goal wrap-up fixture: an autonomous round reports the goal blocked with a reason; the generated <goal_blocked> wrap-up is spliced into the next step, the model writes the closing message, and the turn ends completed with the goal persisted blocked.

dshSource.note: Constructed from dsh update_goal blocked semantics and renderWrapupContext; no live blocked recording exists in snapshots.

config.note: blockedAfterConsecutiveRounds is configurable; the fixture sets 1 (default 3) so one round exercises the wrap-up.

tokens.note: Recorded workspace path; the fixture host substitutes its temp workspace.
System prompt text token; the prompt is pinned by the P1 plain-turn fixture.
Whole tool-schema array token; the nine schemas are pinned by the P1 fixtures.
Goal command identity; generated as goal-cmd-1 by the fixture host.

fixtureOrdinalTokens.note: Ordinal message identity bound to goal-round-goal-1-1-1.
Ordinal message identity bound to system-1.
Ordinal message identity bound to assistant-1-1.
Ordinal message identity bound to msg-1.
Ordinal message identity bound to goal-wrapup-goal-1-2.
Ordinal message identity bound to assistant-1-2.

volatile.note: Pinned deterministic goal clock (fixture host now_ms=300); real recordings use wall time.
